title: Provider Fallback Substitution Conformance local control matrix

coverage.expected: conformant; generic live authority gate required

coverage.expected: conformant with legacy E05/E06 hosted vocabulary

coverage.expected: conformant; generic live authority gate required

repo/private path unsafe, symlink or SHA mismatch

important_gap: E05/E06 v1 provider-account provenance vocabulary is hosted-route-specific. E07 forbids pretending a local/project-owned runtime has a provider account and explicitly requires a future generic live-authority gate for those fallback kinds.
